metadata.gitb:name: [x.epcis-2.0.1.document] Validate an uploaded GS1 EPCIS / CBV 2.0.1 document (SHACL)
metadata.gitb:description: Upload the document as RDF (Turtle, N-Quads or JSON-LD whose @context resolves) and validate it against GS1 EPCIS / CBV 2.0.1, EPCIS document (JSON Schema and SHACL), with the publisher's SHACL shapes of release 2.0.1 as bundled from GS1, GS1 EPCIS / CBV 2.0.1 (commit 6f714682, https://github.com/gs1/EPCIS).

success.default: "The document conforms to GS1 EPCIS / CBV 2.0.1 (x.epcis-2.0.1.document)."

failure.default: "The document does not conform to GS1 EPCIS / CBV 2.0.1 (x.epcis-2.0.1.document). The failed step's report lists every finding."
